_review: reviewed source text (English). Scheme titles and document names come from the mock portal seed (rules/*.json), not from here.
greeting: Hello! Let me check which welfare schemes you qualify for.
ask_annual_income: What is your family's total income in one year?
match_one: {title}: you qualify, based on your {facts}. It needs {n} documents. Shall I start the application?
match_many: You qualify for {n} schemes, based on your {facts}. The top ones are {top}. Which one shall I apply for?
match_more_one: You can also apply for {title}. Shall I start that application?
match_more_many: You can apply for {n} more schemes, such as {top}. Which one shall I apply for?
all_applied: You have already applied for every scheme you qualify for.
choose_reask: Please tell me the scheme's name, for example {title}.
not_eligible_topic: You don't qualify for the {topic} schemes right now, because {reasons}. Shall I check other schemes?
not_eligible_all: You don't qualify for any scheme right now, because {reasons}.
not_eligible_one: {title}: you don't qualify right now, because {reasons}.
ask_start: Shall I start the application for {title}?
proceed_declined: Okay. Tell me when you want to apply.
confirm_ask: Shall I submit your application for {title}? Say yes to submit.
readback_unsure: I wasn't fully sure I heard this right: {fields}.
confirm_reask: Please say yes to submit, or no to stop.
submitted_next: You also qualify for {title}; to apply, say its name.
already_submitted: Already submitted. Your application ID is {app_id}.
status_none: You have not applied for anything yet.
llm_unavailable: Sorry, I can't answer that right now.
